description: Night battle during the Karna Parva. Ghatotkacha (rakshasa-prince, night-fighter) fights for the Pandavas. Karna must use his single Shakti weapon to stop him.

PANDAVA.note: Ghatotkacha has night-fighter trait (+3.0× damage at night) and can FlyOverTerrain.

special_mechanics.night_fighter_bonus: Ghatotkacha's night-fighter trait gives him NightCombatBonus(3.0) — triple damage. He is nearly unstoppable.
special_mechanics.shakti_weapon: Karna has a one-use Shakti astra that kills any target instantly. Using it on Ghatotkacha is tactically necessary but means Karna cannot use it on Arjuna later (Krishna's plan).
special_mechanics.dharma_note: This is a Pandava loss (Ghatotkacha dies) that is strategically a win (Karna wastes his ultimate weapon).
